feeds.title: Loans Canada Blog
feeds.description: Canada's first loan comparison platform. Research lenders, learn about credit, and apply for a loan on the country's largest lender network. Stay up to date with Loans Canada's finance blog. Read about finances in Canada, budgeting, mortgages, financial planning, personal finance and more.

feeds.title: Empire Life Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts on Insurance, Investments and Personal Finance. We are an investment management company exclusively focused on managing investment solutions for Canadians. We believe that we can build your wealth by focusing on high-quality, attractively valued securities over the long term.

feeds.title: Money We Have » Personal Finance
feeds.description: Personal Finance and Budget Travel for Canadians. Money We Have is a respected source for all things personal finance and budget travel. By providing practical money saving tips, readers are able to plan their dream vacation on any budget, and learn how to manage their day-to-day finances. Follow this blog to get all things on personal finance and money saving tips.

feeds.title: More Than Enough Blog
feeds.description: More Than Enough is Canada's most trusted source of financial counsel & products. Their mission is to empower others to manage their financial resources and experience. It facilitates freedom through coaching, equipping & mortgage solutions.

feeds.title: Tembo Financial Blog
feeds.description: Tembo Financial Inc., licensed by the FSRA (Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario), is a non-traditional finance company, offering unique lending services and solutions to its customers. Follow their blog for articles on financial topics, investments, industry news, updates and more.

feeds.title: Objective Financial Partners Blog
feeds.description: Objective Financial Partners is a fee-only, advice-only financial planning firm based in Toronto, Canada that provides flat-fee and hourly fee-only financial planning advice to clients worldwide since 2012. Their blog covers topics related to financial, tax, and estate planning advice and similar topics.

feeds.title: MoneySense
feeds.description: MoneySense is a digital magazine and financial media website. Journalists and qualified financial professionals produce the content. MoneySense's goal is to provide the most relevant and up-to-date information possible. The magazine is helping Canadians learn about personal finance and make better financial decisions.

feeds.title: Financial Post
feeds.description: Read the latest breaking news, updates, and headlines. Financial Post offers information on the latest national and international events and more. For more than 100 years, Financial Post Magazine has been Canada's most trusted source of financial news. It has been Canada's Business Voice since 1907.

feeds.title: Credit Canada Blog
feeds.description: Credit Canada, Canada's pioneering non-profit credit counselling agency, updates its blog frequently with debt management insights. With a mission to facilitate debt relief, they offer free credit counselling, debt consolidation, and management solutions, empowering individuals to reclaim their lives from debt.

feeds.title: My Life, I Guess Blog
feeds.description: The personal finance/lifestyle blog of Amanda, a 33 year old from Northern Ontario ambitiously trying to live a life worth blogging about. Money, Mistakes & Making the Most of It. Keeping the Person in Personal Finance since 2013.

feeds.title: PlanEasy Blog
feeds.description: Follow PlanEasy Blog and Learn about personal finance topics that impact us all. Get tips to help plan your finances in the best way possible. PlanEasy helps make financial planning easy. They handle all the tough calculations and integrate applicable government programs to create a personalized financial plan for you.

feeds.title: Pillar Financial Services
feeds.description: Pillar Financial Services is a solution-based lender in Ontario, Canada that provides flexible financing options for residential, rural, and construction mortgages. Their articles page contains insights and resources for mortgage brokers and borrowers to navigate lending in today's construction market

feeds.title: Hoyes Michalos Blog
feeds.description: Hoyes, Michalos and Associates Inc., founded in 1999, specializes in debt relief, offering insights on bankruptcy, consumer proposals, and debt relief through their blog. With podcasts, videos, and articles authored by licensed insolvency trustees, they've dedicated over 20 years to providing individuals with a fresh financial start.

feeds.title: Jackie Porter Blog
feeds.description: Jackie Porter is a Certified Financial Planner and Financial Advisor with over 20 years of experience. She is the founder of Jackie Porter Financial, a financial planning firm that helps busy professionals take control of their finances. Jackie's blog provides helpful financial advice and tips on a variety of topics such as investing, loans, dept, Tax planningand more.

feeds.title: Jessica Moorhouse Blog
feeds.description: Explore Jessica Moorhouse's personal finance blog for expert advice on debt, credit, budgeting, and more. As a money expert and Accredited Financial Counsellor in Canada, Jessica's platform has evolved into one of Canada's top financial education resources. Her focus is on providing support and guidance to millennials in an easy-to-understand, non-judgmental manner.
